primaryKeyword.zh-CN: Canvas 指纹检测：哈希变化、稳定性与读回异常怎么判断

rows.intent: Tool and diagnostic explanation. Users want a live result and to interpret stability or spoof warnings.
rows.gap: BrowserLeaks explains the drawing/hash method and population sample; WebBrowserTools emphasizes persistent/random noise detection. Neither replaces a controlled profile lifecycle record.
rows.informationGain: A same-input four-run worksheet for baseline, refresh, restart and profile B, distinguishing rendering changes, blocked reads and privacy defenses without treating one hash as personal identity.
rows.demandEvidence: Actual public SERP query and selected result-body review; not first-party queries or measured search volume

primaryKeyword.zh-CN: WebGL 指纹检测：Renderer、ANGLE 与图像哈希怎么读

rows.intent: Inspect GPU/rendering report and explain abnormal or missing renderer fields.
rows.gap: BrowserLeaks exposes many parameters; WebBrowserTools provides image/noise tests. Large field dumps need a decision process for masked versus unmasked fields and expected implementation differences.
rows.informationGain: A field-to-action table for context/version/vendor/renderer/extensions/image hash and controlled hardware-acceleration observations, separating software/ANGLE layers from claimed physical GPU.
rows.demandEvidence: Actual public SERP query and selected result-body review; not first-party queries or measured search volume

primaryKeyword.zh-CN: 浏览器时区与语言检测：偏移、夏令时和请求头一致性

rows.intent: Diagnose disagreement across IP geolocation, browser locale and date/time formatting.
rows.gap: TrustMyIP provides direct mismatch guidance and mabl explains legitimate locale/timezone testing. Broad match/mismatch labels can hide travel, multilingual users, DST and IP location uncertainty.
rows.informationGain: A layered observation sheet for IANA zone, date-specific offset, navigator languages and Accept-Language with legitimate disagreement cases and minimal-change retest.
rows.demandEvidence: Actual public SERP query and selected result-body review; not first-party queries or measured search volume

primaryKeyword.zh-CN: 浏览器代理 DNS 泄漏检测：解析器结果与真实路径边界

rows.intent: Run DNS test and determine whether resolution follows intended proxy/network configuration.
rows.gap: Results focus on tools and resolver locations. Browser-triggered authoritative observation is often conflated with packet-level proof or complete anonymity.
rows.informationGain: Separate observed recursive resolvers from browser/system/proxy resolution paths; use baseline/retest and explain DoH, anycast, IPv6 and inconclusive tests.
rows.demandEvidence: Actual public SERP query and selected result-body review; not first-party queries or measured search volume

primaryKeyword.zh-CN: BrowserLeaks 与 CreepJS 对比：选检测工具与核验原版入口

rows.intent: Compare diagnostic tools and decide which report to use for specific checks.
rows.gap: SERP mixes the original open-source CreepJS project with a similarly named independent domain; vendor review links the independent domain while attributing it to original author.
rows.informationGain: A task-first capability matrix, trusted original deployment, and repeatable cross-tool record that does not compare incomparable scores or treat one checker as platform identity evidence.
rows.demandEvidence: Actual public SERP query and selected result-body review; not first-party queries or measured search volume

primaryKeyword.zh-CN: User-Agent 与 Client Hints 检测：请求头和 JavaScript 怎么核对

rows.intent: Inspect actual user-agent/client hints values and reconcile differences or absent high-entropy fields.
rows.gap: BrowserLeaks and WhatIsMyBrowser show values while MDN explains API disclosure. Reader needs a conditions-aware comparison rather than a simplistic strings must match rule.
rows.informationGain: Four-layer UA worksheet with HTTP User-Agent, navigator.userAgent, navigator.userAgentData and Sec-CH-*; explain Accept-CH, secure contexts, policy, GREASE and legitimate unavailable fields.
rows.demandEvidence: Actual public SERP query and selected result-body review; not first-party queries or measured search volume

primaryKeyword.zh-CN: 开源指纹浏览器怎么选：内核、GUI、许可证与维护成本

rows.intent: Find inspectable browser projects and compare scope, licensing and operational needs.
rows.gap: SERP mixes engine, launcher and profile-manager products. Nextbrowser comparison labels all Camoufox MIT although original repository distinguishes components; open source is also wrongly equated with never using cloud.
rows.informationGain: Separate engine versus launcher versus GUI layers and component licenses, official release provenance, maintenance/sync boundaries and developer integration cost; no untested ranking or benchmark.
rows.demandEvidence: Actual public SERP query and selected result-body review; not first-party queries or measured search volume

primaryKeyword.en: browser cookies localStorage IndexedDB isolation test
primaryKeyword.zh-CN: 浏览器环境隔离测试：Cookie、localStorage 与 IndexedDB 的 A/B 验收

rows.intent: Check that separate profiles do not share website state, beyond whether APIs work.
rows.gap: Broad query returns API-selection explanations and a first-party storage functionality test. BrowserCheck explicitly states its single-origin round trip does not prove profile isolation.
rows.informationGain: A dedicated same-origin A/B random marker procedure per store, new-tab/refresh/restart matrix and scoped cleanup that distinguishes sessionStorage lifecycle, copied profiles and server sessions.
rows.demandEvidence: Actual public SERP query and selected result-body review; not first-party queries or measured search volume

primaryKeyword.zh-CN: 浏览器更新后指纹变化怎么排查

rows.intent: diagnostic regression after browser or system updates
rows.informationGain: Dated before/after baseline, signal-level change classification and workflow regression acceptance; distinct from initial collection and individual signal mechanics
